/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import requests,re
query=''
base='https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/Blast.cgi'
params={'CMD':'Put','PROGRAM':'blastn','DATABASE':'wgs','QUERY':query,'ENTREZ_QUERY':'txid34827[Organism]','HITLIST_SIZE':'20','ALIGNMENTS':'10','DESCRIPTIONS':'20','FORMAT_TYPE':'JSON2_S'}
r=requests.post(base,data=params,timeout=60)
text=r.text
for pattern in ['RID','QBlastInfo','error','Error','Please','Unable','No']:
    for m in re.finditer(pattern,text):
        print(pattern, text[max(0,m.start()-100):m.start()+300].replace('\\n',' ')[:400])
        break
print('len',len(text))
print(text[-1000:])
PY"
